title: US Fighter Jet Strikes Cargo Ship Running Iran Blockade in Gulf of Oman
detail: A US military fighter jet conducted a strike on a cargo vessel attempting to run the Iran blockade in the Gulf of Oman. The US Navy disabled the ship, confirming active American naval and air enforcement of the blockade around Iran. The strike marks an escalation in direct US military action against blockade-running vessels.

media.caption: US fighter jet conducts strike on cargo ship attempting to run Iran blockade in Gulf of Oman

title: Trump Weighs Joining Saudi Retaliatory Strikes on Houthis After Riyadh Airport Attack
detail: US President Trump condemned a Houthi attack on Riyadh's airport as 'terrible' and said the US is evaluating whether to join Saudi Arabia's retaliatory strikes on Houthi forces in Yemen. The statement marks a potential new front in the broader Iran-proxy conflict, as Houthi forces — backed by Tehran — continue to target Saudi infrastructure. Trump's comments signal growing US alignment with Saudi Arabia against Iranian-backed proxies.

media.caption: Trump says US is evaluating joining Saudi retaliatory strikes on Houthis after Riyadh airport attack

title: Iran's Security Chief Accuses Trump Administration of Oil Smuggling Near Oman
detail: Iran's top security official publicly accused the Trump administration of orchestrating oil smuggling operations near Oman, escalating diplomatic tensions amid the ongoing US-Iran confrontation. The accusation signals Iran's attempt to reframe the US naval enforcement posture in the Gulf of Oman as illicit activity, raising the rhetorical stakes in the bilateral standoff.

media.caption: Iran's security chief accuses Trump administration of oil smuggling near Oman
